name: custom_axis/multi_rate
description: One plot with two curves on independent horizontal time axes that share the amplitude axis. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore tabs, headings, descriptions, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent plot with a legend is visible. Two horizontal axes are stacked below the plot area, and neither overlaps the plot area or the other axis. Do not evaluate tabs or other content outside the plot.

Two horizontal axes are stacked below the plot, each with its own title and its own row of tick labels: Slow channel time (s) from 0 to 10 above, and Fast channel time (s) from 0.0 to 0.5 below. Do not judge axis line or tick colors. Fail only if an axis is missing, shows the wrong range, or its labels overprint the other axis; do not infer overlap from proximity or aligned ticks.

A blue slow settling response rises from 0 and settles with small oscillations near 0.8 Amplitude. An orange fast damped chirp starts with large swings and oscillates faster with decreasing amplitude toward the right. The legend names Slow settling response and Fast damped chirp with matching colors.

Within the plot, axis titles, tick labels, and legend text are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.

Axes, grid, tick labels, legend, and both curves are visually distinguishable, and no plot element is blank or corrupted. Labels and the legend close to the plot or window edge are acceptable while they are readable; fail only if label or legend text is visibly missing characters.
